entities.summary:
The meaning of secular is usually understood as "worldly", but when contrasted with cloistered monasteries a cathedral is technically a saecular institution with secular clergy. In vocal music of the classical tradition of western music, 
secular music is is distinguished from both liturgical and devotional religious music were the two main genres of Western music during the Middle Ages and Renaissance era. In such a context the oldest written examples of secular music are songs of the goliards with Latin lyrics.
